newsitem.title: KENYA: Prices mixed at Kenyan tea auction.
newsitem.headline: Prices mixed at Kenyan tea auction.

text.p: Tea prices were mixed at Monday's Kenyan export auction in Mombasa, traders said.
Brighter and medium BP1s were discounted by up to two U.S. cents while lower mediums and plainer sorts were firm to two cents dearer. Brighter and medium PF1s held steady.
Brighter and mediums PDUSTs were firm while lower mediums and plainer types gained 2-4 cents. Brighter and medium DUST1s appreciated by up to two cents.
Fannings were irregularly dearer with quality but corresponding Dusts tended easier. BMFs continued to gain value.
Egypt and Pakistan blenders were the main buyers.
